leadText:
Grover (Japanese: エノキ Enoki) is a character of the day who appeared in Infinite Possibilities!. Grover is the caretaker of a forest in Kanto.

When Professor Cerise was a young boy, Grover took care of him a lot. One day after Professor Cerise saved a from a , Grover and Cerise helped to heal its leg when it was injured and when it was healed, they said goodbye to the Clefairy.

Years later, Grover reunited with Professor Cerise and his daughter Chloe after her fell into a pond chasing after a . After seeing a Poliwag evolve into a , Grover chatted with Professor Cerise and Chloe, commenting on how Grover had caused the forest to grow. After a while, Professor Cerise and Chloe left Grover as they headed to their campsite.
